title: PRESSER | Chris Beard, Corey Stephenson & Ilias Kamardine - Postgame vs. Clemson (11-23-26)
text: Uh we have Coach Beard, Corey, and Ilas joining us here. Coach, what did you uh think about your first game in Maui? [snorts] It's kind of a dual trip for us. Uh the competition of this tournament and this year's team. Um we're looking forward to the opportunity. A lot of respect for today's opponents. That's a good win for us for a lot of reasons, but really the top of the list is how much respect we have for Brad and Clemson. Um dually important. Uh first time Old Miss has ever been to the Maui Invitational. And so we're still in the early stages of building the program in Oxford, but this is exactly the stage that we want to get our program to on a consistent basis. >> All right. Any questions for uh Cory or Ilas? We have a handheld mic over here. >> Um for both players, um it it was clear from the jump um you were trying to impose uh your will on Clemson. What was uh some of the things that coach wanted you to do uh to disrupt them offensively? I think the main thing that was set the tone early and that's what we did. We we trying to play hard every possession and that was the the the main thing on the on the from the start. >> Yeah, just set the tone. You know, we real big on defense so we try to, you know, make it a you know, real big thing. So, you know, set the tone. >> Any other questions for the players? >> Good. I'm just curious about what was it? Was it something in the scout or what was it that had you in attack mode right from the beginning? It seemed like you had made up your mind that you might have had you you I don't know if you felt who was guarding you or if that was part of the scout or you just knew that you could take it, but it seemed right from the jump that you had that in mind that you're going to you're going to be the one to attack and and kind of set the pace and that you had somebody that you could take. Um, I mean, I think I we got a lot of people like me on the team, so you know, I just think I just got going. You know, we got a lot of other players that can get going just like me. So, you know, I don't It wasn't nothing like that. You know, no game plan or nothing. Just >> Yeah, just me. >> All right. Anything else for the players? >> All right, guys. We'll let you get back with your team. >> Hold that bus for me. I'm coming. Yes, sir. Any questions for coach? >> Yeah, coach. Um, coming into the game, you guys had great warm-up. How did it feel getting up so early in the game? >> Yeah, I think you know any college basketball game, the way we describe it to our guys is you got 10, four-minute games. And we do put a lot of emphasis on trying to f start the both halves in a really well way. You know, today in the first half, it's just kind of like complimentary basketball. You hear a lot of times in football, defense has to help the offense, offense has to help the defense. So, in the first half, you know, our offense was hitting on all cylinders. Um, then our defense was, I thought, really impressive. Um, really the difference I think in the both halves was we did a good job playing defense in the first half without fouling. Uh, I don't think they made a free throw in the first half and then just like I knew Brad Wood, he made his team very aggressive. So, it's kind of a different game in the second half. But I thought in the first half our offense was helping our defense and our defense was helping our offense. >> All right, coach. Thanks for being here. We'll see you tomorrow. >> Does anybody know where Miss What city are we in? >> Oxford, Mississippi. Oxford, Mississippi. Thank you.
